market_pricing_in:
At $435.36 per share, Mr. Market is pricing Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) at multi-trillion-dollar valuation multiples—32.4x normalized Owner Earnings and 31.3x Enterprise Value to Owner Earnings—that assume the current artificial intelligence infrastructure supercycle will persist indefinitely without a cyclical digestion phase.

The critical disconnect is whether current earnings represent a mid-cycle baseline or a cyclical peak in high-performance computing (HPC) capital expenditure. Investors paying 32.4x Owner Earnings are effectively ignoring the impending margin dilution from scaling 2-nanometer (N2) production, the structurally higher operating costs of overseas fabs in Arizona and Japan (150–250 bps permanent margin drag), and the reality that non-AI segments like smartphones, automotive, and consumer electronics remain subdued.
